top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at GFNY Cannes. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 68 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Cannes' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
97ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
6,604ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
At GFNY Cannes, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Cannes. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Cannes. Train it until it feels boring.
6,604ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
68 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Smooth pedaling at 68 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.
Low-cadence force work supports 6,604ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

race_overlay.weather: April in Cannes, French Riviera, France — Mild Mediterranean spring conditions; early morning climbs may be cold and shaded with potential dew on descents. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks, including rain protection and wet-road braking before GFNY Cannes. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Cannes' 68 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at GFNY Cannes. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The technical descents at GFNY Cannes demand practice on similar paved roads. Ride mixed terrain at race-day cadence weekly. Practice braking points, corner entry, line choice, and accelerating smoothly out of turns. Confirm tire pressure and equipment before race week.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 68 miles of mixed terrain in Cannes, French Riviera, France.
